item.title: Luther Vandross, Melissa Etheridge, and INXS Nominated for Rock and Roll Hall of Fame!
item.description: A huge congratulations to Luther Vandross, Melissa Etheridge, and INXS on their nominations into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame Class of 2026 🎶 This recognition celebrates their lasting impact on music and culture, and the first nomination for all three legends. Fan voting is officially OPEN – head to vote.rockhall.com and cast your vote once a day for your favorite artist. Make your voice heard.

item.title: Remembering Neil Sedaka
item.description: Remembering the Legacy of Neil Sedaka We are deeply saddened as we remember the legendary Neil Sedaka. A brilliant songwriter, beloved performer, and one of pop music’s most enduring hitmakers, Neil’s music helped define generations of popular song. Our hearts go out to his family, friends, collaborators, and the countless fans around the world who were touched by his music. item.title: PRIMARY WAVE MUSIC PARTNERS WITH KOOL & THE GANG’S ROBERT “KOOL” BELL
item.description: TERMS OF THE DEAL WILL SEE THE PUBLISHER PARTNER WITH BELL ON HIS MUSIC PUBLISHING CATALOG, AS WELL AS HIS RECORDINGS SONGS INCLUDE “LADIES NIGHT,” “CELEBRATION,” “GET DOWN ON IT,” “JUNGLE BOOGIE”, “HOLLYWOOD SWINGING” AND OTHERS NEW YORK, NY (March 10, 2026) – Primary Wave Music, the leading independent publisher of iconic and legendary music in the world, has announced today its partnership with legendary musician, singer, songwriter, and founding member of Kool & The Gang, Robert “Kool” Bell.
